idea-plugin.name: Custom Sound Alert
idea-plugin.description:
Custom Sound Alert

Assign your own audio notifications to common IDE events so you can step away from the screen and still know what just happened.

  • Build success & build failure
  • All tests passed & one or more tests failed

Configure everything under Settings → Tools → SoundBuild: pick a .wav or .mp3 file per event, set a global volume, and preview each sound with the Test button. Sounds play asynchronously and never block the IDE.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.2

  • Fixed: the Settings → Tools → SoundBuild page now appears. (The extensions namespace attribute was wrong, so the settings page was never registered.)

1.0.1

  • Compatibility: removed the upper IDE bound so the plugin installs on newer releases, including Android Studio 2025.3 "Panda" (build 253) and later.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Custom sounds for build success/failure and test success/failure.
  • WAV and MP3 support, per-event Test button, and global volume control.
  • Settings persisted across IDE restarts.
